name: battle-effects-remaining
reviewNotes: Reviewed all 141 remaining records against original glyph sheets. This finished selection preserves the 28 frozen v45 entries unchanged.

Width samples use eight-cell names with two-cell suffixes and five-digit numbers. Records 15,67,70,81,82,100,143,146 have two actor/suffix pairs on one original line, sampled as five-cell names plus one-cell suffixes; caller bounds require native verification. Single 09 fields are item, spell, castle or reinforcement names, sampled at eight cells. Record 67's fifth field is an item. Record 143 fields 5,6,7 are item8, actor8, suffix2; 144/145 end with an item field.

Keep castle repair by 300 separate from full repair. Preserve the merchant's spell-price fields and the sixteen-mon kick wording. Popularity below 30 causes refusal to eat millet dumplings; the loud cry seals spells on both sides. Records 88-95 adapt Japanese puns to Chinese while retaining their subjects; editorial review remains required.

Amanojaku's 100000 attack and level-99 boasts are dialogue, not verified mechanics. Preserve the snowman's 1000 ice blades and battle restart, theft of money versus objects, transfer of stolen MP, and defection to the enemy. Music attacks reuse existing natural/fortissimo/crescendo terminology; remaining musical labels are provisional editorial translations.
